'''''Hypericum tomentosum''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] of the St. John's wort [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] ([[Hypericaceae]]) that is found in the western [[Mediterranean Sea|Mediterranean]].{{r|MySpecies}}{{r|POWO}}
